pharos_demo_1.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {name:'PTGS2'})-[r:gene_associated_with_condition]->(d:Disease) RETURN d.name AS disease, r.source AS source, r.knowledge_level AS knowledge_level, r.id AS evidence ORDER BY knowledge_level, disease LIMIT 50
